real_defects.issue: currencyDecimals() read Intl's maximumFractionDigits (CLDR display digits), not ISO 4217 minor units as its comment said. A correct CFDI 4.0 in COP, HUF, IDR, PKR, LBP, AFN, IRR (ISO 2) or IQD (ISO 3) drew 10 false findings (MX-010 on every amount, then MX-030/033/034/035 from sums rounded to whole units), in invoices and in Pagos 2.0 MonedaP/MonedaDR checks; the answer also varied with the runtime's ICU version. Fixed with a static ISO 4217 table, a failing test first, and a guard test that fails if any einvoice-preflight module reads fraction digits from Intl again.
